outcome: Exclusive breastfeeding rate at 6 weeks postpartum
cohort: 130 singleton pregnant women without delivery complications at the HRH Princess Maha Chakri Sririndhorn Medical Center in the Nakhon Nayok province
finding: The Breastfeed Observation Aid, translated into Thai, demonstrated good validity and reliability for predicting exclusive breastfeeding rates at 6 weeks postpartum.
